resources.audioSecondsTypical: ~2-5 seconds per 11s clip on consumer GPU (8 steps)

notes: The fast, small variant — 341M parameters, 11-second maximum clips, 8 diffusion steps with pingpong sampler. Released as part of Stable Audio Open under Apache 2.0; commercial use is unrestricted by the license. Designed for production-grade SFX and short music loops. For longer clips and higher quality, use the full stable-audio-open-1.0 manifest. The runner can do CPU inference but a consumer GPU is strongly recommended for usable latency.
